The Lionguard have regrouped, and we are ready. With our allies from the Vigil, Durmand Priory, and the Order of Whispers, we will storm Lion's Arch, establish rally positions, cut down Scarlet's forces, and take the fight to Scarlet herself.

After a year of suffering, invasion, and death at her hands, we have Scarlet right where we want her. Come to Lion's Arch with your rage and your best weapons. Show no mercy to Scarlet and her damned followers. Today begins a battle that will be sung about for years to come. Fight alongside me as we take back our city and wipe Scarlet off the face of Tyria forever.

To battle!

Attn: Lady Joon

It is our profound displeasure that we must report our findings re: employee 44236 (Mai Trin).

As you are aware, MinTel has had misgivings about the trust you decided to place in Ms. Trin, ever since the security incident in which you were first made aware of her. It is now our duty to inform you that your trust was indeed misplaced. Ms. Trin has an extensive criminal history in her home country of Kryta, and these are only the incidents our agents are aware of. We find it extremely likely that there exists evidence of even more damning acts. Ms. Trin is responsible, in part or in whole, for:

• Assassination of one Captain Theo Ashford.
• Attempted coup of the Captain's Council in Lion's Arch.
• Resisting arrest and flight from justice.
• Attempted murder of Captain Ellen Kiel of the Lionguard.
• Attempted murder of a prominent Pact Commander.
• Numerous counts of assault, insurrection, and anarchy as captain of the nefarious gang of brigands named Aetherblades.
• Aiding and abetting the violent and illegal acts of a famed Krytan criminal Scarlet Briar.

As noted above, this list is (we believe) only a partial account of Ms. Trin's past actions, but even so, the crimes which we are now fully aware of are more than enough for us to recommend that Ms. Trin be terminated and taken into MinSec custody immediately. We await your prompt response in this matter.

strings.en:
The Stewards of Galdra have welcomed our arrival in leyspring, but they're highly particular about our usage of the Hall of Assemblage. Many of them maintain, or at least feign, optimism that the seers will return to Castora, and thus, tidiness is of the upmost priority. Lyhr has asked that we respect this request of theirs, given the...sensitivities of their situation. Most of them seem to understand—if one can truly say that a steward "understands"—that the time elapsed between their creator's departure and the present is vast, and thus it is likely that seerkind is gone. But as I said, others remain sanguine.  
  
In their efforts to keep the halls and ateliers clean, a notably anxious steward warned me of five chak that have been known to terrorize the leyspring. The stewards theorize that these chak are organized, referring to them as the "helmsmen" of the broader hive. Even named them! I've asked the scouts to keep an eye out just in case, but I suspect the stewards are running a little frantic given current events.
